messages.subject: Announce: Workshops, USA, Jan 2005
parts:
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Workshop: Introduction to Distance Sampling for Onithologists
11-14 January 2005, Flagstaff, Arizona, USA
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.workshop.arizona/
Taught by members of CREEM, University of St Andrews

Having contacted everyone who pre-registered for this workshop, we have now
opened the workshop for general registration. As of today, there are 10
places left. We expect the workshop to fill, so if you'd like to attend,
please register as soon as possible!

More details about this workshop are available from the web site above.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Workshop: Introduction to Distance Sampling
5-7 January 2005 Fort Collins, Colorado, USA
http://www.cnr.colostate.edu/FWB/Workshops/distance.htm
Taught by faculty from Colorado State University and University of Alaska
Fairbanks.

This workshop is open for registration -- for more details see the web site
above.
